findings.title: The archive-move match takes any archived folder ending in -<name>, so another change's archive can reset this change's birth
findings.recommendation: Match the archive move exactly as the spec words it (orbit/changes/archive/<date>-<name>/) and as findArchivedDir already does (^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}-<name>$): use the pathspec :(glob)orbit/changes/archive/[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-<name>/.openspec.yaml, and add a test where change n's metadata is deleted in the same commit that archives foo-n.
findings.reproduction: Disposable repo against dist: propose n (Touchpoints src/a.ts) and foo-n; commit n's apply emit; in one commit git mv orbit/changes/foo-n to orbit/changes/archive/2026-01-02-foo-n and git rm orbit/changes/n/.openspec.yaml; then restore n's metadata with a widened design (Touchpoints src/). changeCommits(root, "n") returns not-begun (the widened plan read at HEAD) instead of frozen at the original fixed point, because the glob *-n matches 2026-01-02-foo-n.

walk_entry.title: Recreating metadata resets the frozen reference

commentary: Verified the two system walks (the fresh pass's and the codex pass's) over the union of their sweep scopes: tripwires.ts, tripwire-touchpoints.ts, program-brief.ts, the orbit-tripwires delta, design.md and the three test files. Each fix was read in place and each claimed site checked: the birth rule and the uncommitted window, the own-paths measure with its named limit and scenario, the effective on_fire in the evidence, the strict reading check (the change's own brief renders over its real trail), and the committed-only limit in the spec, design and the brief's clean line. The converged reused-name finding was correctly recorded stale in the codex log, pointing at the fresh log. The residual check (git diff from afcb0782, the commit adding the latest independent pass) lists eight files, all inside the entries' edit records. One probe, run against dist in a disposable repository, showed the archive-move glob is looser than the spec words it. The reading step did not run: the brief orbit renders for 26 selected records is too large to dispatch verbatim, so those records remain unread and will be counted at archive.
passes_skipped: 0: a VERIFICATION-genre pass does not run a whole-change pass
6: a VERIFICATION-genre pass does not run a whole-project pass

reading: the rendered brief is 155,670 characters (26 records, the architecture doc and every cited requirement embedded); this session cannot hand it to a reader verbatim, so no reader ran and the records stay selected

verification.title: A reused name whose new change is not yet committed is measured as the archived change, not read as uncommitted
Merging the default branch into the change's branch makes the measure count the merged work as the change's
The reading's evidence shows the on_fire setting at the reference, which is not always the value that decided the halt
Recreating metadata resets the frozen reference
Malformed readings can produce a false clean statement
Document that uncommitted work can remain invisible through archive
